description: no-new-privileges is enabled and userns-remap is not set. The mirror image of containers-docker-permissive, and the pair is what proves the two checks read the option each owns: CONTAINERS-0002 passes here and CONTAINERS-0001 fails, while the hardened fixture passes both. It is also the fixture for an icc key absent from a file that does exist, which CONTAINERS-0003 must fail: Docker's default is permissive, so a key nobody wrote leaves the bridge open.
